items.title: Confounding by severity and sedation
items.whyItMatters: The crude association largely disappears after adjustment (claim c3).
items.opportunity: Count only eligible days, match on ventilation duration, adjust for severity score and deep sedation days.

items.title: No evidence on partial adherence
items.whyItMatters: Trials compare mobilising with not mobilising (claims c1, c2), not missed days within a bundle.
items.opportunity: Estimate the association per missed eligible day.

items.title: Secondary questions may take over
items.whyItMatters: The director's day-3 marker and extra ICU days are different questions with different designs.
items.opportunity: Keep them secondary and descriptive; do not let them change case or control definitions.

items.title: Night and weekend mobilisation
items.whyItMatters: Patients admitted before weekends may miss more mobilisation.
items.opportunity: Record day of week for missed days.

reevaluation: A nested case-control design with eligible-day exposure and severity handling remains appropriate; secondary questions are contained.
summary: Four gaps; confounding and partial adherence are high severity.
